cards.card_text: Daniel says PERES means Belshazzar's kingdom has been divided and given over to the ___ and Persians.
cards.verse_text: PERES means that your kingdom has been divided and given over to the Medes and Persians.”
cards.snippet: …your kingdom has been divided and given over to the Medes and Persians.”

cards.card_text: And they want the king to sign it under the law of the Medes and Persians.
cards.verse_text: Therefore, O king, establish the decree and sign the document so that it cannot be changed—in accordance with the law of the Medes and Persians, which cannot be repealed.”
cards.snippet: …it cannot be changed—in accordance with the law of the Medes and Persians, which cannot be repealed.”

cards.card_text: Under the law of the Medes and Persians, once King Darius signs this decree, it cannot be repealed.
cards.verse_text: Therefore, O king, establish the decree and sign the document so that it cannot be changed—in accordance with the law of the Medes and Persians, which cannot be repealed.”
cards.snippet: …it cannot be changed—in accordance with the law of the Medes and Persians, which cannot be repealed.”

cards.card_text: The king answers that by the law of the Medes and Persians, the order stands.
cards.verse_text: So they approached the king and asked about his royal decree: “Did you not sign a decree that for thirty days any man who petitions any god or man except you, O king, will be thrown into the den of lions?” The king replied, “According to the law of the Medes and Persians the order stands, and it cannot be repealed.”
